f_c(x) = 2.95 f_k(x) = -0.47 margin M(x) = 3.42 zero-baseline margin -13.76 contrastive IG completeness error 3.6%
A. Input (filtered, z-scored); shaded = 4 windows with the highest contrastive (margin) attribution
B. Single-class IG for AFIB (logit f_c) - red raises, blue lowers; SAME colour scale in B and C
C. Contrastive IG for AFIB vs TWO (margin f_c - f_k) - red raises, blue lowers; SAME colour scale in B and C
colour scale: +/-0.237 logit units per 20-sample block (99.5th percentile over both maps)
D. Window evidence for the margin
Red (up): evidence for the target over
net 17.80 (= M(x) - M(0) up to IG error)
E. Lead sums (grey: single-class; colour: contrastive)
Attribution describes the MODEL's sensitivity along the zero-baseline path; it is not evidence of a physiological cause. No region is labelled with a clinical finding.
